subject: general
question: _______ is a branch of zoology that deals with the study of amphibians and reptiles.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Herpetology.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Herpetology is the study of reptiles and amphibians.
 
• The study of pancreas, liver, biliary tree, gall bladder, and their disorders is known as Hepatology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andrology** is the medical speciality that deals with male health, particularly relating to the problems of the male reproductive system and urological problems that are unique to men.
 
• The branch of biology that deals with the study of cells are called Cytology.
 
• **Gerontology **is known as the study of old age.
